title: Appeal to Authority
skills: define and recognize an appeal to authority
evaluate whether a cited authority has relevant expertise
distinguish credible expert evidence from unsupported authority claims
assess arguments for appropriate evidence beyond reputation or status
alignment_note: Explains appeal to authority and helps students evaluate when expert testimony is relevant and when authority is being used as a substitute for adequate evidence. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, source credibility, argument analysis, research literacy, and critical thinking across high school English courses.
